notes.title: Faraway Complete Desktop Trilogy Bundle
notes.content:
[h2]All three Faraway games for desktop are now available as a bundle, at a better price! 🏷️[/h2]

🛕 Begin your journey with Faraway – explore ancient temple ruins holding mysterious riddles and challenges and that will engage both your eyes and your mind.

🌴 [b]Continue the adventure with Faraway: Jungle Escape.[/b] Your journey leads you through lush jungles that present a whole new set of challenges for you to overcome.

🧊 Complete the trilogy with Faraway: Arctic Escape. This time you find yourself in the middle of an icy landscape, and your puzzle-solving skills are the only thing that will get you through it.

[h3]Check out the bundle below and dive into the beautiful worlds and thoughtfully crafted puzzles of Faraway. [/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39541/Faraway_Complete_Desktop_Trilogy/?beta=1
